title: Account activation is logged with required details
gherkin:
Feature: Audit Logging for Account Activation
  Scenario: System logs account activation event
    Given an account exists in inactive status
    When an administrator activates the account
    Then an audit log entry is created
    And the log entry contains the account identifier
    And the log entry contains the activation timestamp
    And the log entry contains the administrator identifier
    And the log entry is available for administrative review
rationale: Account status changes (activation) are explicitly required to be logged per operative context. This test verifies that activation events are captured with sufficient detail for administrative review and accountability.
usedContextItems: System shall log account status changes (activation, suspension, deletion)|The system shall ensure that audit logs are available for administrative review
